tagline.en: minWM's Wan2.1 Action2V route — a lightweight, action-conditioned world model driven by motion tokens.
tagline.zh: minWM 的 Wan2.1 Action2V 路径——轻量、由动作 token 驱动的动作条件世界模型。

en: minWM Wan Action2V is the Wan2.1-based route of the minWM interactive world model from Shengshu AI's MIN Lab. It generates video conditioned on actions, letting you drive the world with motion inputs and camera control.

This route builds on the compact Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B backbone and uses a dedicated Wan2.1 Action2V entrypoint with a DMD (distilled) sampler and native action tokens, so movement is expressed directly to the model. WorldFoundry pulls only the single Wan2.1 Action2V DMD weight it needs from the large upstream minWM repository.
In WorldFoundry you provide the starting state and action/camera inputs, and the pipeline generates an action-conditioned clip. Its smaller backbone makes it the lighter of the two minWM routes.
zh: minWM Wan Action2V 是数生科技 MIN Lab 推出的 minWM 交互式世界模型中基于 Wan2.1 的路径。它以动作为条件生成视频,你可以用运动输入和相机控制来驱动这个世界。
该路径构建在紧凑的 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 骨干之上,使用专门的 Wan2.1 Action2V 入口,配 DMD(蒸馏)采样器与原生动作 token,让运动直接传达给模型。WorldFoundry 只从体量庞大的上游 minWM 仓库中拉取所需的单个 Wan2.1 Action2V DMD 权重。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你提供起始状态与动作/相机输入,pipeline 便生成一段动作条件视频。较小的骨干使它成为两条 minWM 路径中更轻量的一条。

whenToUse.en: Use this route when you want a lighter action-conditioned world model on a compact Wan2.1 backbone, driving the scene with native motion tokens and camera control.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个更轻量、基于紧凑 Wan2.1 骨干的动作条件世界模型,用原生动作 token 与相机控制来驱动场景时,适合使用该路径。

notFor.en: The upstream minWM repository is very large; only the single required Wan2.1 Action2V weight is fetched. It expects action/motion inputs rather than text-only prompting.
notFor.zh: 上游 minWM 仓库体量很大;只拉取所需的单个 Wan2.1 Action2V 权重。它需要动作/运动输入,而非纯文字提示。
